name: get_drawing_info
author: hprebar
title: Get drawing info
description: Summary of the active drawing: file name, INSUNITS and measurement system, millimetres per drawing unit, model-space extents (null until the drawing has any; as of the last regen/save) in mm, current layout and layer, layer count, and optionally the number of model-space entities per DXF type. Read-only.

countByType.description: Count model-space entities per DXF type
